content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is a cloud storage solution that can be used for digital product storage and delivery. What's more significant is that it can be integrated with NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, eliminating the need for PayPal or Stripe. This combination provides a sovereign digital commerce stack that puts creators in control of their products and finances without relying on centralized platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Cloudflare R2 stores digital products, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles automatic delivery. NOWPayments processes payments in cryptocurrencies, converting them to USD at transaction time. The infrastructure is built on a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosted website, with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handling backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Using this infrastructure, creators can retain 99.5% of their revenue, compared to 89.5% with Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure today, start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates for building and deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack. Then, follow these concrete steps: host your website on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, and configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automatic delivery.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
This solution eliminates the need for PayPal or Stripe, reducing fees by 9.5%.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a way to sell digital products without relying on centralized platforms, this post is for you. For more information on how to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Our kit includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, providing everything you need to succeed.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this infrastructure today, follow these steps: host your website on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automatic delivery, and store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, deliver files using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With these steps, you can create a sovereign digital commerce stack that puts you in control of your products and finances.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I store digital products on Cloudflare R2?
To store digital products on Cloudflare R2, simply upload your files to your Cloudflare R2 bucket, and then use the Cloudflare R2 API to integrate it with your website's backend logic.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT.
How do I configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automatic delivery?

To configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automatic delivery, you'll need to set up a trigger that fires when a new order is received, and then use the Cloudflare R2 API to deliver the product to the customer.
What order storage options are available?
You can store orders in either Supabase or Google Sheets. Both options provide a scalable and reliable solution for managing customer orders.
Can I use this infrastructure with other payment processors?
Yes, you can use this infrastructure with other payment processors, but NOWPayments is the recommended option due to its low fees and ease of integration.
